issue: Account funding was counted as daily trading profit through equity minus tracked starting balance.
correction: Typed broker history separates funding/credit/bonus/correction from realized trading P/L and trading charges. Current floating P/L excludes account credit.
day_and_week: UTC realized non-funding P/L plus current floating P/L. Positive calendar opening balances reconstructed from balance-affecting deals; first-funded periods use funded capital as denominator. This is not a time-weighted return.
scope: Account-wide, including manual trades; not proof of Atlas-only earnings.
failure_behavior: Unknown, duplicate or canceled deal evidence is unverified. Profit is unknown and RiskManager refuses entries until accounting is available.
cache: 15 seconds; invalidated immediately by account, balance, equity, credit or UTC-day change.
deployment: Graceful backend restart after matching demo account, zero positions and zero pending orders confirmed. API returned corrected verified accounting.
private_evidence: Exact account amounts remain in ignored local storage; not included in this portable report.
